name: Seeking Strahad
summary: In Orgrimmar, Gan'rul Bloodeye sends warlocks south to Ratchet for deeper training. There, a human summoner teaches arts beyond the reach of basic summoning.

sections.title: Leaving the Shadows of Orgrimmar
sections.body: Gan'rul Bloodeye trains young warlocks in the Cleft of Shadow, where they learn to command the Nether. When an apprentice outgrows that teaching, Gan'rul points them beyond the city walls. More volatile beings call for instruction from someone with deeper mastery of dark arcana.

sections.title: An Unorthodox Alliance
sections.body: Gan'rul sends apprentices to Strahad Farsan, a human sorcerer in a tower above Ratchet's goblin port. Horde and humans may be enemies, but warlocks look beyond ordinary faction loyalties. Power, discipline, and ritual knowledge matter more than ancestry. Strahad judges an apprentice by their inner hatred and ability to subjugate, not their skin color.

faq.q: Why is an orc warlock sending me to a human?
faq.answer: Warlocks value dark knowledge over racial loyalties. Gan'rul Bloodeye knows Strahad Farsan has rare skill in advanced demonology, and a tutor's knowledge matters more than faction lines when seeking dangerous summons.

faq.q: Where can I find Strahad Farsan?
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan lives on the high bluffs above Ratchet in the Barrens, outside his tower overlooking the goblin port.

aliases: what do i get from strahad
faq.answer: Strahad teaches the rituals to bind a felhunter, a magic-devouring demon from the Twisting Nether. He studies occult texts with warlocks, then tests their ability to enslave the beast.
Gan'rul Bloodeye is a prominent orc warlock mentor in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He trains burgeoning Horde warlocks in the basics of fel magic and summoning lesser minions.

faq.q: Is there another way to start this quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Forsaken warlocks receive a similar summons from the Magic Quarter in the Undercity, directing them to the same human mentor above Ratchet.

faq.q: Does Ratchet pose any danger to Horde warlocks?
faq.answer: Ratchet is run by the Steamwheedle Cartel and remains a neutral port. Keep the peace and do not attack travelers within the city, and goblin bruisers leave you alone.

angles.text: As a warlock, you are moving toward mastery of mid-tier demonic beings, and your readiness to subjugate the magic-consuming felhunter is being tested.
As a member of the Horde, you see how warlock covens work beyond the Warchief's formal diplomacy: their masters send apprentices to a solitary human.
